trial_court: Court of District Judge, Alwar (D.B. Civil Misc. No. 12002/2012)
case_name: Shri Pradeep Kumar Pandey vs Smty Nirmala Devi And Anr

parties.respondent_defendant: Smt. Nirmala Devi and Another (wife and children)

facts_of_case: Appellant's marriage was solemnized with respondent no.1 on 20.2.1994. Differences cropped up, and respondent no.1 deserted the house. Appellant filed a divorce petition under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act. Respondent no.1 filed an application for maintenance allowance. Trial court allowed the application and directed Rs. 2000/- per month to be paid by appellant husband.

legal_principles.principle: The amount of maintenance given by the court is within its discretion and will not be interfered with unless there are compelling reasons.
legal_principles.held: the learned Single Judge did not find error in the impugned order and concurring with the same, held that the amount of maintenance was given within the given parameters.

legal_principles.principle: A court's order regarding maintenance allowance will not be interfered with unless there are compelling reasons.
legal_principles.held: Thus, the learned Single Judge did not find any ground to interfere with the impugned order of the District Judge, Alwar and dismissed the writ petition.

outcome.final_order: Delay of 181 days is condoned, and impugned order is maintained.
